The model is one component of the system. The course is about the rest of it.
Heterogeneous work split: CPU for tokenization, kernel launch, data movement and tool calls, GPU for matmul. Prefill is compute-bound, decode is memory-bandwidth-bound.
Floating-point addition is not associative. A 7th-decimal shift in a matmul can flip the next token.
Weights from GBs to TBs, KV-cache in 10s to 100s of KB per token, prefix-cache reuse, and parallelism across GPUs.
MHA, GQA, MLA, NSA, linear attention. Workloads: multi-turn chat, problem solving, RAG, agents.

elements.text: Two processors, two very different jobs
Everything around the matmul - tokenization, kernel launch, data movement, tool calls - lands on the CPU.
Execution time depends on the length of the output, which complicates scheduling. The two phases of one request want different hardware.

slides.title: A new kind of programmable computer

elements.text: A new kind of programmable computer
An agent is an autonomous software system that uses an AI model to reason about a goal, use external tools, and execute multi-step actions until the task is finished.
The agent harness as OS is the object Lecture 2 opens up and Lecture 4 designs from first principles.
An LLM is a new kind of programmable computer, with a different programming model and a different failure model.

slides.title: Agent serving is a chain, not a request

elements.text: Agent serving is a chain, not a request

The critical path spans GPU, CPU, storage, network and external services. Inference is the cost center, and efficiency, reliability, performance and sustainability are the framing the course inherits.
The objective is to maximize task success subject to latency, cost, resources, reliability and security. Throughput is the wrong objective.

slides.title: Three things to carry out of Lecture 1

elements.text: Three things to carry out of Lecture 1
This is a systems course: the object of study is the whole agentic serving system, not the model.
Agents are a new kind of computer with a new programming model and a different failure model, so their systems problems do not map onto classic request/response serving.
Optimize task success per dollar and per unit of energy, not tokens per second. Every agentic workload property is a systems problem this course will solve.
